# Stunt Car Racer for Lovers

> Free modern remake of Geoff Crammond’s classic Amiga game *Stunt Car Racer*. Play in the browser or download for Apple Silicon Mac. Two-player races, Amiga+ physics, Enhanced Look (SCR palette).

Site: https://nmarchand73.github.io/StuntCarRacerForLovers/
Source: https://github.com/nmarchand73/StuntCarRacerForLovers

## Play free online

- [Browser WebAssembly build](https://nmarchand73.github.io/StuntCarRacerForLovers/play/): no install, keyboard or gamepad recommended.

## Download for Mac

- [Apple Silicon DMG](https://nmarchand73.github.io/StuntCarRacerForLovers/download/StuntCarRacerForLovers-macOS-arm64.dmg): drag to Applications; first launch via Fix macOS Gatekeeper.command or System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway (unsigned).

## What it is

Stunt Car Racer for Lovers is an open remake based on [StuntCarRemake](https://github.com/ptitSeb/stuntcarremake), itself based on Geoff Crammond / MicroProse’s Amiga classic. It keeps flat-shaded SCR aesthetics and adds shared races plus optional Enhanced Look scenery.

## Key features

- Amiga+ physics (toggle **U**)
- Speed Feel FOV/blur (toggle **I**)
- Enhanced Look rails, horizon, clouds, cube field (toggle **O**)
- Single-player races with AI opponents
- Track packs: Classic, TNT, Original, Loops

## FAQ

**Is it free?** Yes — browser and Mac DMG.

**Is it the original Amiga ROM?** No — it is a remake.

**Where is the source?** https://github.com/nmarchand73/StuntCarRacerForLovers
